d: Aartiphishiyal intelijens (AI), aadhunik taknik aur kaushal vikas ke kshetr men bihar ko naee pahchan dilane ke uddeshy se rajdhani patna men 'global eaaee, skils end ejukeshan eksapo-2026' ka bhavy aayojan kiya ja raha hai. aagami 19 se 21 navanbar tak patna ke oorja oditoriyam men aayojit hone vale is tin divsiy eksapo ka udghatan 19 navanbar ko mukhy atithi ke rup men bihar ke shiksha mantri mithilesh tivari karenge.
